slides.title: Project Report - Biller Management Portal
slides.subtitle:
Bill Payment Platform Enhancement to support Standardized Onboarding of Small and Medium Sized Billers
Version 1.1 | November 6, 2025

slides.title: Project Timeline & Current Status
slides.description: The project was planned over a 10-week development cycle. As of November 6, 2025, the project is in Week 6, we are on track with major core development and implementation tasks are partially completed.

rows.notes: All core UI/UX designs are completed
Multi-step admin onboarding wizard fully functional
Admin and Biller self-service web portals

Admin Portal – Complete biller and user management
Biller Portal – Biller specific customer & transactions dashboard

slides.title: Our Solution: A Unified Three Pillar Platform
slides.description: Our solution is a single, unified platform built on three distinct but interconnected pillars that work together to create a comprehensive biller management ecosystem.

columns.heading: Administrator Portal: Control & Oversight
bullets: Full Biller Lifecycle Management: Onboarding wizard, comprehensive dashboard, and detailed profile pages with one-click Approve/Reject functionality.
Advanced User & Access Control: Secure, email-based user invitation flow with dynamic Role-Based Access Control (RBAC) system.
Platform Analytics & Reporting: Admin dashboard with real-time KPIs and visual charts.
Security & Auditing: Dedicated UI to manage Partner API Clients and comprehensive, filterable System Audit Log.

columns.heading: Biller Portal: Empowerment & Efficiency
bullets: Personalized Dashboard: KPI-driven dashboard with "Recent Activity" feed for enhanced user experience.
Customer & Bill Management: Full CRUD operations and Bulk CSV Import tools with validation and preview steps.
Financial Visibility: Master Payment History page and detailed per-bill transaction views.
Customizable Communications: Settings page for billers to manage their own Email Templates for reminders.

columns.heading: Partner API Gateway: Integration & Growth
bullets: Secure & Authenticated: Access protected by securely hashed, unique API keys for maximum security.
Core Capabilities: Endpoints for validating customers, fetching balances, and applying payments seamlessly.
Future-Ready: API is versioned (/v1) and documented, making it easy to add new features and capabilities.

slides.title: Modules & Deep Dive On Features
slides.description: This section maps the deliverables from the original scope to the detailed features that are In Progress.
rows: Admin Onboarding Wizard: Multi-step, web-based wizard for capturing business, contacts, director details, banking and KYC document information.

Admin Portal: Full Biller & User Management dashboards with search and filter.
Biller Portal: Biller-specific customer and transaction views.
Biller Self-Service Portal: Comprehensive web interface for billers to manage workflow, including manual and bulk Excel/CSV bill uploads.

Admin Reporting Module: CSV Settlement Reports generation.
Biller Reporting: Real-time dashboard and Master Payment History Report.
Standardized CSV export functionality integrated into all relevant reporting and data table features.
